prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial photographic image for the AI work automation curriculum card of NEO & PETER, a Korean practical AI education website. Primary request: turn the actual prepared lesson 'conversation and meeting notes into a useful report and next actions' into a believable photograph. A close candid view of a Korean small-business professional's hands at a real warm oak desk: one hand resting naturally on a laptop keyboard, a smartphone laid on the desk displaying a simple audio recording waveform, and a slightly used paper notebook with a few soft out-of-focus handwritten lines. The laptop screen shows a calm real document editor with a few report paragraphs, restrained headings and a small checklist; screen text is out of focus, never the focal point. No identifiable faces. Photorealistic materials, natural hands and fingers, worn paper, matte laptop metal. Natural afternoon window light, warm ivory and muted olive shadows, understated contemporary Korean studio, authentic lived-in details, sophisticated magazine photography, not corporate stock photography. Landscape photograph approximately 5:4, subject centered and readable when cropped to a slightly landscape card or a mobile 16:10 crop, no framing graphics. 50mm lens, gentle shallow depth of field, balanced exposure and natural color. Avoid all illustrated or rendered appearance, diagrams, floating interfaces, glowing AI chips, neon, robots, mascots, holograms, cartoon people, infographics, giant words, captions, watermarks, logos, visible personal data, exaggerated orange color grading. There must be no overlaid text. One single coherent photograph, no collage.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial photographic image for the AI blog and content curriculum card of NEO & PETER, Korean practical AI education. Primary request: photograph the prepared lesson 'use a photo and everyday experience to create a useful blog post for a small business'. A candid three-quarter overhead close view of a real cafe owner's creative workspace beside a window. A matte silver laptop shows a realistic quiet blog editing canvas with one large cafe photograph and a few softly defocused text paragraphs, no legible headings or brand names. Next to it a smartphone shows a matching cafe photograph, a simple ceramic coffee cup, and a small notebook for story notes. Only a single person's natural hands, one selecting a photo on the laptop trackpad and one resting near the phone, no identifiable face. Background is an understated actual-feeling Korean cafe with warm wood and a small green plant gently blurred. Real editorial photography, authentic natural texture and minor imperfections, same cohesive warm ivory, oak, charcoal and muted olive palette as a contemporary practical learning academy. Soft natural window light, gentle realistic shadows, 50mm lens, no artificial glow. Landscape approximately 5:4, main laptop, photo and hands centered to survive 16:10 mobile cropping; pleasant clarity rather than dramatically blurred foreground. No illustration, no 3D rendering, no stock-photo posed smiles, no infographic arrows, no giant English or Korean typography, no synthetic circuit boards, no robot, no neon, no floating UI, no watermarks or brand logos. No overlaid text, no collage. One convincing photograph of photo-to-blog creation.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial photographic image for the AI short-form video curriculum card of NEO & PETER, Korean practical AI education. Primary request: transform our prepared lesson 'turn a business idea into a vertical short video with images, voice and editing' into a genuine-looking studio workspace photograph. Three-quarter eye-level close photograph of a warm wooden desk with a smartphone held vertically in a modest compact tabletop tripod, recording a ceramic coffee cup at a small local-business setup. A real laptop beside it shows a realistic dark video editing application: a 9:16 portrait preview of the same coffee cup footage, a small audio waveform, a few colored clips on a restrained timeline. The application is a normal physical laptop screen, not an infographic or floating mockup; any tiny labels are naturally out of focus. One person's anatomically natural hands, one lightly adjusting the phone tripod, no identifiable face. A subtle small tabletop microphone conveys voice recording; keep props minimal and purposeful. Same cohesive warm ivory, natural oak, matte charcoal and muted olive palette as an editorial magazine photograph about practical AI learning. Soft afternoon window light, true material texture, 50mm lens, balanced highlights, believable domestic creative studio, no advertising slickness. Landscape photograph approximately 5:4; the full vertical phone and the laptop are both centrally composed and remain readable in a slightly wide mobile crop. No extra phones, no illustration, no 3D render, no pixel art, no cartoon office scene, no infographic arrows, no glowing circuitry, no robot, no neon, no floating interfaces, no giant typography, no overlaid text, no logos, no watermarks. One single coherent photorealistic photograph.
